title: He Did Not Marry Low Maintenance
human_truth: Zuv did not marry someone easy, quiet, polished, or low maintenance. He married Aachu's expressive emotional weather, and the love is that he stays gentle without making her feel like too much.
emotional_arc: anti-ideal hook -> specific emotional truth -> daily-life proof -> rhythm of care -> homecoming payoff
